NewsArticle.Title: Maintenance
NewsArticle.Content: Dark Ages servers will be offline for up to 30 minutes sometime between 9 - 11 p.m. on 9/10 for scheduled maintenance. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
